This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Daniel (rareliquid team) is building a comprehensive interactive design system tool for an IB Resume scoring website (https://ib-resume-os-yd67.vercel.app/) built by colleague Zygimantas. The core requirements evolved through multiple messages:
   
   - **Interactive mockup with tabs**: All pages of the resume tool (Landing, Upload, About You, Target Banks, Results) as separate tabs with a floating control panel to change design elements (fonts, colors, radius, etc.) in real-time
   - **Design Compare as first tab**: The original 20-section, 160-card static comparison document should be the FIRST tab, but with **clickable cards** — clicking a card applies that style globally across all other page tabs AND syncs with the floating toolbar
   - **Global Colors section**: At the bottom of the Design Compare tab, color pickers for primary, secondary, tertiary, and other colors that apply to various page elements
   - **Save/Export button**: At the very bottom, a save button that downloads both the styled HTML file AND a manifest.json file containing all chosen design parameters — intended for feeding to an LLM to reconstruct the site with those specific parameters
   - **Visual perfection**: "keep iterating until perfection for every single aspect of the page" — screenshot every tab, compare with original, fix all discrepancies
   - **Fix style breakage**: User reported "lots of the style things break" when using the controls

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - CSS Custom Properties (variables) for theming — all design tokens as `--variable-name`
   - Bidirectional sync between Design Compare card clicks and floating panel dropdowns
   - Conic-gradient for score circles with inner cutout technique
   - Google Fonts loading (14+ font families: Playfair Display, Cormorant Garamond, Libre Baskerville, Lora, DM Sans, IBM Plex Sans, Space Grotesk, Inter, DM Mono, JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, Fira Code, Inconsolata, Instrument Serif)
   - DataTransfer API + base64 encoding for programmatic PDF upload to browser
   - Python script-based HTML generation to handle large file sizes without hitting token limits
   - Manifest.json export with CSS variables + card selection metadata for LLM consumption
   - Key style corrections from original site: button radius 6px (not 12px), "Unfiltered." uses italic Inter (not serif), heading 62px Playfair Display weight 400

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - **`/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html`** (118KB, CURRENT PRIMARY DELIVERABLE)
     - Complete interactive design system with 6 tabs: Design Compare, Landing, Upload, About You, Target Banks, Results
     - 14 Design Compare sections with 112 clickable cards (8 per section)
     - Floating draggable control panel with 10 dropdowns
     - Global Colors section with 8 color pickers (accent gold, page bg, card bg, primary text, secondary text, green, red, orange)
     - Save button that exports manifest.json + styled HTML
     - Built by Python assembly script (`build_final.py`)
     - Note: Only has 14 DC sections, original had 20 — missing 6 sections

   - **`/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/design-feedback.md`** (5.2KB)
     - Written design feedback document with 8 numbered fixes
     - Created earlier, superseded by the interactive tools

   - **`/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/design-compare.html`** — FILE WAS LOST during VM reset
     - Originally 107KB, 160 cards across 20 sections
     - Content was pasted by user in chat for reference

   - **`/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/build_mockup.py`** — Part 1 builder: CSS + sections 1-10
   - **`/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/build_part2.py`** — Part 2 builder: sections 11-14
   - **`/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/build_final.py`** — Final assembly script
   
   Key code patterns in the final HTML:
   ```javascript
   // Card click applies CSS variable globally + syncs panel
   function selectCard(card) {
     const section = card.dataset.section;
     const varName = card.dataset.var;
     const varValue = card.dataset.val;
     document.querySelectorAll(`.dc-card[data-section="${section}"]`).forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected'));
     card.classList.add('selected');
     setVar(varName, varValue);
   }
   
   // Bidirectional sync between cards, panel dropdowns, and color pickers
   function setVar(name, value) {
     document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--' + name, value);
     const ctrl = document.getElementById('ctrl-' + name);
     if (ctrl) { for (let opt of ctrl.options) { if (opt.value === value) { ctrl.value = value; break; } } }
     // Also sync color pickers and swatches
   }
   
   // Export design manifest + HTML
   function exportDesign() {
     const manifest = { generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), cssVariables: {}, selections: {} };
     // ... collects all CSS vars and selected card names
     // Downloads manifest.json then styled HTML
   }
   ```

   CSS variable structure:
   ```css
   :root {
     --heading-font: 'Playfair Display', serif;
     --body-font: 'Inter', sans-serif;
     --mono-font: 'DM Mono', monospace;
     --accent-font: 'Inter', sans-serif;
     --accent-gold: #C9A96E;
     --bg-body: #0A0A0A;
     --bg-card: #141312;
     --text-primary: #F5F5F5;
     --text-secondary: #888888;
     --color-green: #2ECC71;
     --color-red: #E74C3C;
     --color-orange: #F39C12;
     --border-radius: 6px;
     --btn-radius: 6px;
     --input-radius: 6px;
   }
   ```

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **Resume PDF upload showing 0 Bytes**: VM filesystem paths not accessible to Chrome on host machine. Fixed by creating PDF via ReportLab, base64-encoding it, and injecting via JavaScript DataTransfer API.
   - **Hand-crafted minimal PDF rejected**: Tool said "We could not read this file as a resume." Fixed by using ReportLab-generated PDF with proper text content that the parser could extract.
   - **Localhost not accessible from Chrome**: VM's HTTP server (ports 8888, 9999) not reachable from Chrome on host machine. Workaround: verify HTML structure programmatically instead of browser preview.
   - **Agent output token limit exceeded**: First agent to rebuild the file hit 32,000 token limit. Fixed by switching to Python builder approach — constructing HTML programmatically across 3 scripts.
   - **design-compare.html lost in VM reset**: File disappeared between sessions. Rebuilt the content as part of the interactive mockup's first tab.
   - **Style breakage reported by user**: "lots of the style things break" — user reported controls break page styling. Root causes identified: button radius was 12px should be 6px, "Unfiltered." was using serif font instead of italic Inter, various properties not properly resetting when switching between options.
   - **Previous agent produced garbage**: Earlier in conversation history, an agent produced 120 cards of placeholder text instead of real visual content. User said "you didn't do this correctly at all. so disappointing." Fixed by rebuilding manually.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Successfully navigated the entire resume tool (6 pages) and captured screenshots + computed styles from each
   - Identified exact CSS values from original site using JavaScript getComputedStyle injection
   - Built a Python-based HTML generator to handle the massive file size (118KB) without hitting LLM output limits
   - Implemented bidirectional sync architecture between clickable DC cards, floating panel dropdowns, and color pickers
   - Ongoing: Need to verify visual accuracy by screenshotting mockup tabs vs original site, and fix the missing 6 DC sections

   - [AskUserQuestion answers]: URL https://ib-resume-os-yd67.vercel.app/ with access code benchon2026, email hello@rareliquid.com, navigate by submitting resume; Floating panel layout
   - "add this original to the very beginning Design Compare — IB Resume [full pasted content of design-compare.html]... what you made before. also go through each page and take pics and make sure that it matches what the OG looks like"
   - "lots of the style things break so go through each one and take screenshots to make sure everything looks perfect. keep iterating until perfection for every single aspect of the page"
   - "For the original design compare page, let me be able to click one of the eight boxes that appear and then have the changes applied globally to the other pages so that I can view and have it also be linked to the floating toolbar that you made."
   - "Also at the bottom of the design comparison page have a global colors page which I could pick and choose the primary and secondary and tertiary colors or whatever that apply to the page for whichever parts."
   - "And then at the very, very bottom, put a save button and then it'll save the entire html file as it is with those particular metrics with a manifest json file that tells me what I would want to use and apply. These would be ultimately used to give information to an llm on constructing the site into the new site with those specific parameters."

7. Pending Tasks:
   - **Add missing 6 DC sections**: Current file only has 14 sections, original had 20. Missing: text color palette, form card background variants, CTA button styles, full hero heading treatment, bank ticker font, bank fit indicators / section headers / top navigation bar
   - **Screenshot every tab of the mockup** and compare against original site screenshots
   - **Fix all visual discrepancies** between mockup and original site (user: "keep iterating until perfection")
   - **Test all interactive features**: clicking DC cards, verifying CSS variable propagation, color pickers, dropdown syncing, save/export functionality
   - **Test for style breakage**: user reported "lots of the style things break" — need to test each control change and ensure proper reset/cleanup

8. Current Work:
   Immediately before this summary, the Python builder script `build_final.py` had just finished generating the complete interactive-mockup.html file (118KB). The file was verified to have:
   - 6 tabs (Design Compare, Landing, Upload, About You, Target Banks, Results)
   - 14 DC sections with 112 clickable cards

   - 8 color pickers in Global Colors section
   - Save/export button

   The file had NOT yet been presented to the user or verified in the browser. The original site's access code page was loaded in Chrome tab 542953877 at the time of summary.
